conditional_bound_scope: Upper bound over the saved v15 candidate graphs under unchanged pinned forward evidence/config, taking every unassessed graph optimistically. Not newly measured actual support, chemical impossibility or future-policy bound. No failed input is promoted by normalization or sibling graph inference.
interpretation: Preparation count gains did not become viable downstream route gains. Two-step routes declined35→9, while all24 one-step routes remained. Generation times are descriptive across nonrandom historical runs excluding shared catalog load, not causal speedup evidence.
decision: Reject larger-target-first preparation and restore serial preparation exactly. Preserve evaluated commit8bb5104, tests, frozen v15 evidence and failure analysis. No full forward rerun because both missing-support inputs retain only exact paths with saved completed step nonmatches.

next_step: Diagnose bounded atom-origin correspondence between an outer reaction role and inner reverse precursor hints before SMILES conversion.
